steps.what: Assess clinical findings and diagnose musculoskeletal disorders
Treat musculoskeletal disorders or arrange further specialist care

tasks.design: Retain diagnosis and treatment with the physician. The clinical record system {OTHER} provides existing context; no automatic diagnosis or treatment action is introduced.
tasks.enabler_now: General drafting capability does not replace diagnosis or treatment.
tasks.still_hard: Symptoms, function and imaging can disagree.
tasks.human_edge: The physician recognises uncertainty and decides when to investigate or refer.
tasks.altitude: Clinical responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify functional findings during a clinical handoff
reach.learn: Shared functional terminology and referral scope

evidence.claim: Keeping musculoskeletal diagnosis and treatment human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is clinical interpretation and treatment; history capture, examination and test ordering are separately described tasks.
No structured diagnosis flag or machine action is assumed.
Existing clinical tools remain; no custom system is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow changes.
unknowns: Clinical scope and typical case mix
research_questions: Which conflicting findings require further assessment rather than immediate treatment?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Clinical judgement and treatment retain time; no documentation saving is duplicated.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Order and interpret laboratory and imaging investigations

steps.what: Select appropriate laboratory tests or diagnostic imaging for the clinical question
Order the selected test with patient-specific clinical information
Interpret test results and imaging reports in the clinical context

tasks.design: Retain test selection, order approval and result interpretation in the clinical ordering and results system {OTHER}. The digest's breast-imaging capability does not establish performance for sports-injury imaging or this physician's clinical interpretation.
tasks.previous_blocker: The correct investigation and meaning of a result depend on the clinical question.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing electronic ordering supports work without establishing a new saving.
tasks.still_hard: Incidental findings and nondiagnostic results need clinical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The physician judges what a test can answer and how its result affects further care.
tasks.altitude: Ordering and interpretation authority remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Transpara flags breast cancer on mammograms; this does not establish a capability for sports-injury imaging or clinical interpretation of all test results.
Retaining test selection and interpretation is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary excludes diagnostic-service acquisition and reporting. After s2, the diagnostic service produces the result through its unchanged existing work before s3; no outside-labour saving is claimed.

The physician captures and checks patient identity, requested test, clinical question and relevant patient details in s2. All 15 hours remain; missing data requires manual clarification. No automatic order is proposed.
Native clinical ordering remains; no custom interpretation or order-generation system is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because no process changes.
unknowns: Available diagnostic services and order workflow
research_questions: Which referral details are needed for the diagnostic service to address the clinical question?

already_counted.description: Order capture and final clinical release check

approvals.approved_version: Exact test order, patient identity, clinical question and patient-specific details; changes require another physician check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Selection, order capture and interpretation retain time; external diagnostic work is not in this denominator.

tasks.short: Record athlete histories and perform physical examinations

steps.what: Elicit athletes' medical histories and capture relevant source observations
Record and check the athlete's medical history in the clinical record

loop.input: Physician-captured observations with chronology and uncertainty
loop.output: History draft separating athlete reports from confirmed history
loop.check: Physician verifies injuries, chronology, negation, medication and qualification against source observations before filing
loop.stop: One draft; ambiguous identity or unsupported facts require manual history entry
loop.why_not_simpler: Test native dictation first; narrative history may require bounded drafting into record sections

steps.what: Perform the physical examination and assess observed findings

tasks.design: Keep history-taking and physical examination with the physician. Draft the captured history into the clinical record system {OTHER}, then require the physician's meaning check before filing; no examination finding is generated from text.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narrative history entry can duplicate the physician's already-captured account.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound clinical drafting can shorten record wording while preserving the interview and examination.
tasks.still_hard: Athlete reports, prior diagnoses and observed findings must remain distinct.
tasks.human_edge: The physician asks clarifying questions and observes the actual patient.
tasks.altitude: Less history typing, with clinical assessment time protected.

evidence.claim: Autoscriber drafts clinical consultation records for clinician validation; this supports drafting capability, not a validated sports-examination substitute.
The athlete-history adaptation and savings scenario are E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is history capture, history recording and physical examination, not diagnosis, treatment or a second full encounter note.

The physician produces patient/encounter ID, source attribution, injury history, dates, medication account and uncertainty in s1, retaining all 35 hours including capture or dictation. Missing facts require manual clarification, not model inference.
Test native dictation and templates before custom drafting. Positive s2 remaining time includes full final review and filing; physical s3 remains unchanged.
Allow four focal hours for template and failure upkeep beyond routine checks.
unknowns: Current history-typing burden and dictation support
research_questions: Does drafted history preserve attribution and chronology while reducing total record time?

already_counted.description: History interview, capture and draft validation

approvals.approved_version: Exact history note, patient/encounter identity and source observation snapshot; any changed statement requires another physician check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R90 gross10 minus4 upkeep =6 net. High requires a manual history-entry burden; low covers effective existing dictation or heavy correction. Interview and examination time remain.

tasks.short: Educate and counsel on illness and injury prevention

steps.what: Provide education and counseling on illness and injury prevention

tasks.design: Retain prevention counselling and checking understanding with the physician. Existing approved materials in {DOCS} support the discussion without replacing personalised explanation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prevention advice depends on activity, goals and practical constraints.
tasks.enabler_now: Information availability does not establish shorter counselling with equivalent understanding.
tasks.still_hard: Patients may misunderstand risks or find advice impractical.
tasks.human_edge: The physician adapts advice and recognises when a different approach is needed.
tasks.altitude: Counselling responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify practical barriers to agreed prevention advice
reach.learn: Training context and clinical referral boundaries

evidence.claim: Keeping individual prevention counselling human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is education and counselling, not creating printed materials or tracking an exercise programme.
No machine action or free structured behavioural profile is presumed.
Existing approved references suffice; no custom build is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no process change is introduced.
research_questions: Can patients explain the advice and identify feasible next actions after counselling?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Personal counselling stays counted; no hypothetical handout-generation share.
